statement_draft: [방법론 실패 규칙] KR quality_profitability standalone long-only는 구조적 실패. (1) GP standalone(Novy-Marx 2013), (2) Cash-based profitability(Ball 2016) DART 현금흐름 의존, (3) Growth stability composite IS-only은 모두 OOS 소멸. EXCLUSION: Quality가 overlay로 작동하는 멀티팩터 블렌드(QMJ+MOM, quality+value 등)는 scope 밖 — Q07 Earnings Stability는 STR_1679 defense sleeve에서 유효.

scope_draft.exclusion: quality as overlay in multi-factor blend (QMJ+MOM, quality+value, defense sleeve within multi-sleeve portfolio) — Q07 Earnings Stability in STR_1679 is valid use

evidence_draft.note: 3건 모두 Grade F/C, MDD 54~94% hard fail, standalone mode. 방향 일치.

attempts.description: STR_1655 Growth Stability Composite Diversifier standalone — IS SR 0.60 → OOS SR 0.00
STR_1657 Cash-Based Profitability Quality(Ball 2016) standalone — DART 현금흐름 데이터 품질 이슈로 시그널 역방향 작용
STR_1626 Profitability Fortress(Novy-Marx 2013) standalone — IS SR 1.044이지만 OOS retention 0.24 + recent 3Y SR 0.135 alpha decay

exception_counter.note: Quality as overlay(QMJ+MOM 등) 성공 예시는 본 scope 밖이므로 counter에 포함하지 않음. STR_1679 Q07 defense sleeve는 exclusion에 의해 scope 밖.

falsification_draft.note: Supporting L-code 3건 = 3개 independent construction (GP/cash/composite) standalone mode에서 일관된 실패

mechanism_draft.economic_explanation: KR quality_profitability standalone long-only의 구조적 실패 3요인: (1) Novy-Marx(2013) GP premium은 2020년대 성장주 랠리로 recent 3Y SR 급격히 약화(STR_1626 0.135). (2) Ball et al.(2016) Cash-Based Profitability는 DART 재무 현금흐름 항목의 가용성·일관성 문제로 시그널 품질 저하(STR_1657 MDD 94%). (3) Growth Stability composite는 IS overfit, OOS 완전 소멸(STR_1655 retention -0.001). 공통 원인: 한국시장에서 quality premium은 standalone long-only로 재현 불가 — value/momentum overlay 또는 멀티팩터 blending 필수 (Asness 2019 QMJ는 value와 결합 시 유효).

oos_validation_draft.calculation_method: simple mean of OOS retention ratios: (0.24 + 0.00 + -0.001) / 3 = 0.08
oos_validation_draft.note: STR_1626 retention 0.24, STR_1655 retention 0.00, STR_1657 retention -0.001. IS 대비 92% 열화.

expiry.trigger_review_if: (a) 한국 quality premium 반등 증거 3건+ OOS, (b) DART 현금흐름 데이터 품질 개선, (c) 성장주 랠리 종료 징후

revision_note: AX-004 v1 (scope too broad) deprecated 2026-04-17. Re-enrich with scope limited to standalone_long_only mode + explicit exclusion.
